blocks.text:
**Dates:** 30 December 2026 – 9 January 2027

This programme brings together very different experiences. The ocean and New Year fireworks give way to tropical forest and the roar of waterfalls. Next come the broad avenues, old neighbourhoods and tango of Buenos Aires. The final part of the journey takes you to Chile, where you will explore Santiago's historic centre, Santa Lucía Hill and the capital's modern districts.
